notablePrerequisites:
Fiendlash attached to Blightsteel Colossus.
Your lifetotal is greater than the number of opponents you have.
description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each player and creature.
Fiendlash triggers, causing Blightsteel Colossus to give an opponent at least thirteen poison counters.
The opponent loses the game due to infect damage.
Repeat for each remaining opponent.
